#### info-3 — Stochastic H-infinity preview (InfoHinfPreview-2)

- **Original target:** Solve stochastic H-infinity preview synthesis under the literal printed criterion, not the inequivalent mean-square replacement.
- **Adopted at exact scope:**
  - For one fixed deterministic stationary law on the original constant-data one-Brownian infinite-horizon plant, zero state/history and finite `h>=0`, with all canonical progressive expected-`L2` inputs, strong all-input well-posedness/nonexplosion, uniform same-input `STATE-LOC`, actual zero-window EMS, the Hilbert window and finitely many fixed taps, and local pathwise control admissibility, `G2 <= G1 <= 2sqrt(2)G2` in the extended reals; the upper constant is nonsharp. Earlier quantitative, same-`gamma` and `h=0` applications retain their separate domains.
  - For every positive-parameter two-state v15 plant and finite preview `h`, the same specified stationary left-tap law has `G1=G2=dc/a`; under that law a legal zero-start pulse has infinite expected control path-`L2` after the delayed pulse and invalidates a drift-only mean, despite local pathwise admissibility. For infinite horizon, `u=0` attains the all-controller optimum; uniform-strict feasibility is `gamma>dc/a`, pointwise-strict feasibility `gamma>=dc/a`. This is not general synthesis or a finite-horizon result.
  - The v16 gate supplies pathwise diffusion-annihilating adjoint necessary bounds with both endpoints zero, the stated singular-Gram obstruction, and exact infinite-horizon synthesis for the entire positive-parameter interacting `R=0` two-state family. Unknown competitors require only local pathwise control-`L2`; stronger energy is established separately for the constructed control.
  - The v21/v25/v26 risk union includes the stated scalar mean gap, bounded output-priced necessity, descriptor and uncontrolled calibrations, and abstract quotient. Its nonlinear bridge applies only under `CP`; finite-terminal `CYL` norming conditions the raw dual on `F_T`. No computed scalar literal gain, common controller or general synthesis follows.
  - The v27–v32 union gives `norm_* <= nu <= sqrt(2) norm_*`, the stated canonical constant-data descriptor sandwich and uncontrolled EMS mixed/RMS identity. Under AHEAD on that domain, `G2 < G1 <= sqrt(2)G2`; the `0<rho<gamma`, `Y1=0` and finite-terminal Q1 qualifications remain, as do `NR-HISTORICAL-V14`, `NR-V15`, `NR-LARGER-FILTRATION-BSD` and `NR-POLICY/CP`. NEW v244 supports v55 items1–3 for the uncontrolled scalar plant `dX=(-aX+c w(t-h))dt+sigma X dW`, output `z=d X`, symbolic `a,c,d,sigma>0`, `q0=2a-sigma²>0`, canonical one-Brownian filtration, zero state/history and progressive E2 inputs: `G2(h)<=2cd/q0` for finite `h>=0`, its eligible-input energy identity, and `G2(0)=2cd/q0`. The signed-input Fubini and distinct truncated-response/noncircular E2 MINOR overlays are mandatory. This prospectively pays only the scalar RMS-value input at `NR-GATE-I-WHOLE-V21`, not the whole v21 source at the v220/v244 cut; inherited v31/v32 composition gives `g12_inf=2cd/q0 < G1_inf <= sqrt(2)(2cd/q0)` for that zero-delay family.
- **Candidate/operational boundary:** All other v33–v57 packets, v54 and v55 Corollary G1 remain UNREVIEWED; author preview-delay/statement errata are mandatory, not corrected historical acceptances. A corrective freeze on new packets began at 08:52:47 after the distinct v56 and v57 pre-pin drafting MINORs. v248 records the Fubini/Gramian-equivalence report without finding either consumption or nonconsumption. Realization C1–C3/R4 remain STOPPED; the recorded as-of state is honest idle, not continuous work.
- **Original problem:** **OPEN:** the literal general synthesis criterion, including the stated controller and domain gaps, is not resolved.
- **Evidence:** [Parent 1](/Users/jinleic/repos/aifours/institute/runs/three-area-2026-10-23-96h/preview-v220-v27-v32-value-side-entire-parent-v1.md) · [Parent 2](/Users/jinleic/repos/aifours/institute/runs/three-area-2026-10-23-96h/preview-v244-gate-I-RMS-value-and-energy-identity-entire-parent-v1.md) · [Complete row-level evidence and pins](/Users/jinleic/repos/aifours/institute/runs/three-area-2026-10-23-96h/report-ledger-census-precutoff-v2.json).
